title: School, Countries & Toys
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 revision booklet: school subjects, countries & toys pages

scenes.t: Yahia learns many subjects at school: English, Math, Science, Arabic, and ICT.
In Math, we learn numbers and shapes. In Science, we learn about living things and materials.
In English, we learn to read, speak, and write. In ICT, we learn to use computers safely.
Yahia also learns about countries around the world. Different countries, one big world!
France has the Eiffel Tower. Italy has the Colosseum. China has the Great Wall.
And Egypt, our country, has the great Pyramids of Giza!
After school, Yahia plays with his toys: his ball, his kite, and his robot.

items.a: We learn about the natural world and how things work.
We learn numbers, shapes, and problem solving.
We learn how to use computers safely and wisely.
We learn about the Earth: countries, maps, land, and water.
We learn about the past: people, events, and important dates.
We learn songs and musical instruments.
We play sports and exercise at school.
